name: excel-mcp-server
description: Create, read and edit Excel workbooks without Microsoft Excel
long_description: Work with .xlsx and .xlsm files: read and write cells, formulas and dates, format ranges, add tables, charts, conditional formats and data validation, and inspect VBA macro code. Access is limited to the folder you choose, and formulas that reach the network or other programs are blocked.

workbook_directory.title: Workbook folder
workbook_directory.description: The folder the server may read and write Excel files in, including its subfolders.

tools.name: create_workbook
tools.description: Create a new, empty Excel workbook.

tools.name: describe_workbook
tools.description: List a workbook's sheets with their used ranges, plus its defined names.

tools.name: list_workbooks
tools.description: List Excel files in a directory.

tools.name: export_workbook
tools.description: Return the workbook file itself as an embedded base64 resource.

tools.name: import_workbook
tools.description: Save an uploaded workbook file on the server, e.g. to edit it remotely.

tools.name: describe_sheet
tools.description: Describe a sheet's structure: used range, frozen panes, merged ranges, tables, charts, data validation, conditional formats and custom column widths.

tools.name: create_sheet
tools.description: Add an empty worksheet.

tools.name: rename_sheet
tools.description: Rename a worksheet. Formulas that refer to the old name are not updated.

tools.name: copy_sheet
tools.description: Duplicate a worksheet (values, styles and dimensions) within the workbook.

tools.name: delete_sheet
tools.description: Delete a worksheet and everything on it.

tools.name: insert_rows_or_columns
tools.description: Insert empty rows or columns before position `at`, shifting the rest down or right.

tools.name: delete_rows_or_columns
tools.description: Delete rows or columns starting at position `at`, shifting the rest up or left.

tools.name: read_range
tools.description: Read cell values as rows. Dates come back as ISO 8601 strings.

tools.name: write_range
tools.description: Write values into cells, overwriting what is there.

tools.name: clear_range
tools.description: Clear the values and/or formatting of a range without shifting other cells.

tools.name: copy_range
tools.description: Copy values and formatting to another place, overwriting the destination.

tools.name: find_cells
tools.description: Find cells whose value contains (or equals) the query.

tools.name: format_range
tools.description: Change fonts, fill, borders, alignment or number format of a range.

tools.name: merge_cells
tools.description: Merge a range into one cell, or split a merged range again.

tools.name: set_sheet_layout
tools.description: Set column widths, row heights, frozen panes, the auto filter and the tab color.

tools.name: add_conditional_format
tools.description: Add a conditional format rule to a range.

tools.name: add_data_validation
tools.description: Restrict what can be entered in a range, e.g. a dropdown list.

tools.name: create_table
tools.description: Turn a range with a header row of unique text labels into an Excel table.

tools.name: create_chart
tools.description: Add a chart that plots a block of data.

tools.name: create_summary_table
tools.description: Group rows and aggregate columns, like a pivot table, writing the result as cells.

tools.name: read_vba
tools.description: Show the VBA macro code in an .xlsm or .xltm workbook, module by module.
